'''Qoen Dervul''' was a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who lived on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Dervul bought, sold, and created artifacts and relics from his shop in the [[Senate Commercial District]].

==Behind the scenes==
Qoen Dervul appears in the [[BioWare]] MMORPG ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as a vendor on Coruscant.
